manga_title: My Wife Is From a Thousand Years Ago 168
text:
Page 001
001-1. ..IFITIS REALLY TOO HOT FOR YOU. YOU CAN MOVE YOUR BED INTO MYROOM.
001-2. you CAN HAVE THE BIG- GER BED BACK AND I'LL TAKE THE SMALL BED.
001-3. WHAT'S THE DIFFERENCEBE- TWEEN DOING THAT AND SWITCHING OUR ROOMS BACK THEN?
001-4. YOU'RE THE ONE WHO DOES NOTWANT TO SWITCHOUR ROOMS BACK.

Page 002
002-1. SLEEPING IN THE SAME ROOM ONSEPARATE BEDS IS DEFINITELY BETTER THAN SHARING A BED TOGETHER,
002-2. OTHERWISE, HE MIGHT TRICK ME INTO HAVING KIDS ATANYTIME.
002-3. EVEN PUTTING SLEEPING MATS FOR SUMMERON MY BED DOESN'T HELP WITH THE HEAT, AND IT LEAVES MARKS ALLOVER MYBODY-
002-4. I REALLYCAN'T LET HER BAKE IN THE HEAT WHILE I'M ENJOYING THE COOL AIR, SO THIS COM- PROMISE SOUNDS LIKE THE BESTSOLUTION FOR NOW.
002-5. I'LL HELP YOU MOVE THE BED OVER ONCE I'M DONE WITH THIS MATCH.

Page 003
003-1. SURE!!!
003-2. LET ME TELL YOU, THE VICTORY CONDITIONOF THIS DECK IS TO SHUFFLE THE CARDS,
003-3. IF YOU'RE ABLE TO SHUFFLE A LARGE AMOUNT OF THESE USELESS RAT CARDS INTO HIS DECK, THE CARDS THAT HE HAS WILL INCREASE,
003-4. AND YOU WILL BE ABLE TO WIN..
003-5. THESE LEGS ARE THE BEST...

Page 004
004-1. I WON!
004-2. LET'SGO FOR ANOTHER ROLND!
004-3. IT'S TIME TO MOVE THE BED.
004-4. AH... INEARLY FORGOT~
004-5. PUTTING TWO BEDS IN THE ROOMWOULDMAKE THE ROOM VERY CRAMPED, AND WE'RE GOING TO BE SLEEPING IN THE SAME ROOM ANYWAY... MOVING THE BED IN ONPUR- POSE SEEMS A LITTLE PRETENTIOUS.
004-6. IT SEEMS LIKE THERE ISN'T MUCH OF ADIFFERENCEBETWEEN MOVINGTHE BEDS TO- GETHERANDSLEEPING ON THE SAME BED..

Page 005
005-1. WELLIT'S POSSIBLE..
005-2. FORUSTO PLACE THE SWORD IN THE MIDDLE OF THE BED,AND WE CAN EACH TAKE UP HALF OF THE BED TO SLEEP ON..
005-3. THAT WOULO BE THE BEST!
005-4. SINCE WE'RE ALREADYWEAR- ING PAJAMAS...
005-5. THAT'S RIGHT!
005-6. YOU CANT BEAT MEIN A FIGHT ANYWAY, I'LL KICK YOU OFF THE BED IF YOU MAKE ANY MOVES ON ME..
005-7. YES YES!

Page 006
006-1. THEN...
006-2. IT'S HAPPILY DECIDED!
006-3. YOU CAN CONTINLE WITH THE GAME, ILL THEOAME TAKE A SHOWER FIRST~ I'LL PACK AND MOVE MY mOVEmY THINGSOVER.ONCEI'MDONE~
006-4. TS/N:

Page 007
007-1. WHEN ARE YOU PLANNING TO GO TO BED?
007-2. I'LL PLAY FOR A LITTLE WHILE LON- GER.
007-3. IN THAT_CASE.. I WLL CONTINLE I WLLCONTINUE TO WATCH SOME VIDEOS THEN... VIDEOSTHEN..
007-4. I DIDN'T EXPECT TO BE THIS SUCCESSFUL, I ORIGINALLY THOUGHT THAT I WOULD HAVE TO FIGHT FOR A SPOTON THE FLOOR FIRST BEFORE SLOWLY MAKING MY WAY UP.
007-5. SHIT..I CAN'T FOCUS AT ALL.
007-6. AHEM,
007-7. IT'S ALREADY 11, ISNT IT TIME FOR BED?

Page 008
008-1. I'LL SHOWER FIRST!
008-2. WHY IS SHE NOT OUT YET, DID SHE FAINT IN THE BATHROOM?

Page 009
009-1. WHY AREN'T yOU SLEEP- YET? ING
009-2. WHY ARE YOU WAITING FOR ME? WE'RE NOT PLANNING ON DOING ANY- THING...
009-3. I'MWAITING FOR YOU...
009-4. THIS GUY IS PUSHING HIS LUCK, I WANTED TO WAIT FOR HIM TO FALL ASLEEP BEFORE BURROW- ING IN BED!
009-5. .YES,WE'RE NOT DOING ANYTHING,LET'S HURRY UP AND IT'S ALREADYLATE~ GO TO SLEEP.
009-6. WE'REOBVIOUSLY NOT GOING TO DO ANYTHING, SO WHY THE HELL AM I SO NERVOUS!

Page 010
010-1. WHY ISN'T THE SWORD IN THE MID- DLE?
010-2. I'MFINE WITH THIS AMOUNTOF SPACE, AND I'M ALSO AFRAID THAT YOU WILL NOT BE ABLE TO SLEEP COMFORTABLY.
010-3. IT'S ALMOST 12,ARE YOU STILL PLANNING TO JUST STAND THERE?
010-4. HOWDID I BECOME THIS IMPULSIVE..I JUST CASUALLY AGREED TO SLEEPONTHE SAME BED AS HIM!
010-5. HOW WOULD SECOND MISS VIEW ME NOW? WHAT ABOUT THETOWNSFOLK? MOTHER-IN-LAW...PTUI, WHAT ABOUT XU QING'S PARENTS?!

Page 011
011-1. WE'RE NOT MARRIED YET..
011-2. HUH?
011-3. I'M NOT AFRAID OF THE WARM WEATHER! I THINK ITS BETTER FOR ME TO SLEEP IN THE OTHER ROOM AFTER ALL!
011-4. AFTER AWHOLE DAY'S WORTH OF WORSK. AND I'M STILL BACK TO SQUARE ONE?
011-5. TS/N:
